title: Thermodynamics of polymerized vacuum regular black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime
summary: We derive a class of vacuum regular black holes inspired by effective loop quantum gravity dynamics and extend the construction to asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The derivation is based on a deparameterized Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi formulation, where an auxiliary dust field is introduced only to define an internal time and does not act as a matter source.
